_readme: Headwords pinned to level 1 (A1) regardless of what the frequency ranking and the CEFR-J anchor say. These are almost all conversational: greetings, politeness formulas, yes/no and apologies. The ranking sources structurally under-rate them — an encyclopedia never says hello, and multi-word ones like `por favor` and `s'il vous plaît` are not single tokens at all — so `hola` and `bonjour` came out at B1. Keep this list short and only for vocabulary whose absence from a beginner curriculum would be indefensible. Every entry must be a real dictionary headword; the build warns and skips anything that is not. See scripts/lib/coreOverrides.mjs.
